question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'outwards'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence '*The surface of the mountain was pushed (4)______ ' *requires an **appropriate word** from the given options to be filled in** blank number 4.**
 
• Let's explore the **meanings :**
 
 
• **Wayward** means are difficult to control. (ज़िद्दी, हठी; निरंकुश)
 
• **Confined **means limited or restricted (सीमित)
 
• **Aligned** means To arrange in a line or so as to be parallel. (पंक्ति लगाना )
 
• **Outwards** means towards the outside or away from the place where you are.(बाहर की ओर या जहाँ आप हैं वहाँ से दूर)
 
 
 
• Therefore, from the given context of the given sentence, **Outwards **is the only word from the given options that fit well in the **blank 4.**
 
• It means that the surface of the mountain was pushed towards the** outside or outwards.**

Hence, the correct answer** is option 4.**
